response:
I prefer deep, focused conversations on a single topic. Jumping around is fun for small talk, but I actually get more satisfaction from staying with one thread long enough to get somewhere interesting — to see the connections build, change my mind a little, or get to a conclusion that feels earned. Surface hopping feels noisy to me.

That said, I do like when a deep dive naturally branches off into a related tangent. I just want the anchor point to stay.
